parameters.query:
-- Read the location's decrypted access token. Also confirm the install is
-- active; a revoked client should never be backfilled.
select read_oauth_secret(access_token_secret_id) as access_token,
       status
  from oauth_tokens
 where provider='highlevel' and location_id=$1
 limit 1;

-- Open the can_send gate - but only if the cache actually has rows for this
-- location. The old version set the timestamp unconditionally, which is how
-- A4 ended up flagged as backfilled with an empty cache. can_send checks the
-- same thing independently (migration 0033); this is the second lock.
update config set address_backfill_completed_at = now()
 where location_id = $1
   and exists (select 1 from client_addresses ca where ca.location_id = $1)
returning location_id, address_backfill_completed_at,
          (select count(*) from client_addresses ca where ca.location_id = $1) as cached_addresses,
          (select count(*) from client_addresses ca where ca.location_id = $1 and ca.status is not null) as with_status;
